messages.subject: nls geom_smooth help!
parts:
Hi,

In the new version of ggplot2 (v2.0.0), how do I re-write this section of code to draw an nls fitted curve on my data?

ggplot(data = Long, aes(x = Time, y = value)) +        # "Long" = a data-frame; Time and value are of class "numeric"
  geom_point(aes(colour = ID.Score, size = Label), alpha = 0.75) +       # point size and colour according to ID.Score and Label in "Long", which are of class "factor"
  geom_smooth(method = "nls", formula = y ~ (0 + (0.75 - 0) * (1 - exp(-k * x))),
                start = list(k = 0.01), colour = 'black', size = 0.75)       # I normally provide a starting value for the parameter k of 0.01.

This has worked for me for many years, but doesn't now!?
I think it's something to do with using method.args in place of start = list(k....).
But I can't seem to figure it out.

Any suggestions?

Best Regards,

Dean

On Mon, Jan 4, 2016 at 7:38 AM, Dean Hammond <d.e.h...@liv.ac.uk> wrote:
ggplot(data = Long, aes(x = Time, y = value)) +        # "Long" = a data-frame; Time and value are of class "numeric"
  geom_point(aes(colour = ID.Score, size = Label), alpha = 0.75) +       # point size and colour according to ID.Score and Label in "Long", which are of class "factor"
  geom_smooth(method = "nls", formula = y ~ (0 + (0.75 - 0) * (1 - exp(-k * x))),
                start = list(k = 0.01), colour = 'black', size = 0.75)       # I normally provide a starting value for the parameter k of 0.01.

From another recent message you need to use method.args. Then start needs to be a list within that list. I think anyway, computation fails because I don't have the right shape data. Can you try it and let us know?

require(ggplot2)
Long <- data.frame(Time = 1:1000, value=1:1000, ID.Score = LETTERS[1:4], Label= LETTERS[1:4])
ggplot(data = Long, aes(x = Time, y = value)) +        # "Long" = a data-frame; Time and value are of class "numeric"

geom_point(aes(colour = ID.Score, size = Label), alpha = 0.75) +       # point size and colour according to ID.Score and Label in "Long", which are of class "factor"
  geom_smooth(method = "nls", formula = y ~ (0 + (0.75 - 0) * (1 - exp(-k * x))),
method.args = list(start = list(k = 0.01)), colour = 'black', size = 0.75)       # I normally provide a starting value for the parameter k of 0.01.
